warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>, C2' — the footing mark plus the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20 x 0.20, 6-DB12 on S-06). C2 is recorded here once (9 points); the columns above the floor beams are C1 on S-02.
9 footings for an L-shaped plan: no footing at C1, C2 or D3. Bay 2-3 ends at row C (F1 at C3); in bay 1-2 the grid-1 and grid-2 beams run B to D with no support at C.
F2 caps (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-05) are drawn with the 0.90 side along x at all six F2 points, including B1 on grid 1.
